name: Universal Car Ball
detailed_description:
Universal Car Ball is about letting everybody who plays the Car Ball Sport to experience it in a way that they enjoy it most <3

Although the main focus is to give players a real alternative to the current Car Ball scene to just enjoy a few good games with friends.  Our primary objective is to build Enterprise community tools that are directly integrated into our game which will allow players, teams, clubs, communities, and organizations to fully manage and their business through the game interface.

Imagine starting a club where players can apply and you can see their stat cards generated by the game itself.  Having scouts on your clubs team that can watch games and flag players for future follow ups.  Running an entire Community with thousands of players with your own Management tools built into the system!

Players

==================================================

*) Play OFFICIAL "Recreational", "Open Competitive", "Professional Scene"

*) Join officially organized sports by mutliple communities from in game

*) View your entire match schedule in GAME with Calendar integration

*) Get Alerts on your phone for matches and request

*) Join "Teams", "Clubs", "Communities", Organizations" as "Free Agent"

Teams

==================================================

*) Form groups of players that want to play together

*) Have your own team "Stadium" customized with your logo

*) Customize a team uniform or look to play team matches

*) Organize internal leaderboards

*) Win Pinnets and Trophies displayed in your Stadium Foyer

*) Join "Clubs", "Communities", "Organizations" as a "Team"

Clubs

==================================================

=========      Everything for "Teams" +PLUS     ============

*) Advertise, Approve and Accept "Teams" or "Free Agents" to your club

*) Have a private stadium with Club Logo

*) Organize Internal Leaderboards & Brackets

*) Manage Teams that Join Your Roster

*) BAN players from your Club and Club Events (internal to club only)

Private Communities

(communities are PRIVATE GROUPS and may  play the game as they wish)

==================================================

==========      Everything for "Clubs" +PLUS     ============

*) 100% Operate your own League!

*) Have your own IN GAME SHOP

*) Accept Prize Pool Donations OR Raise Money via Fund Raisers OR Item Sales

*) Have full control to run a truly organized and customized league

*) Create your own custom game mode that is your official match style

*) Modify: Game Physics, Ball Physics, Custom Ranks, Boost Pads or Powerups

*) Every match queued in your community will automatically play your game mode

*) Allow a seamless experience between your open recreational play and your league play

*) Have your OWN REFEREE's who can rewatch replays, ban players, timeout players, review complaints from matches

*) YOU WILL ESSENTIALLY BE AS IF YOU OWN YOUR OWN SYSTEM 100% INDEPENDANT

Official Organizations (this is the pro scene)

==================================================

==========      Everything for "Clubs" +PLUS     ============

*) Official organizations are licensed for professional game play

*) They get full access to the system and is where the professional scene lives

*) They can view/manage/referee/resolve disputes/ban and otherwise shape the existance of the pro scene

*) Official Orgs are formed through legal contracts that bind them to the fate of the professional scene and are involved in what patches/fixes direction the scene is headed

*) Official Orgs can have fully customized stadiums with Sponsorship placements with real contracts to power the pro scene and fund their teams

*) Official Orgs can have multiple pro teams they put forward and have IN GAME SHOPS to sell decals and items that are specific to their fans to gain direct capital from merchandising

Join us and experience the new and mind blowing physics that is taking Car Ball to the next level! Universal Car Ball is setting the standard for the next decade of professional level sports and graphics being demanded by Car Ball players <3

"Spread the love of Car Ball <3"

"Lets make Car Ball GREAT Again!!!!!!!!!"

"... nos ipsi uniti liberar ..."

With all my love: AudiTistic

short_description: Car Soccer eSports meets true team management and game customization! Play the way you enjoy it most and run private leagues/teams/events players can queue directly in game with your organization. Our goal is to build communities that are able to self manage and bring fun back to Car Ball <3

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Modern 4 Core CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1050
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Modern 8 Core CPU
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3050+
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
